thread:
Maya (ML): FYI quant-smoke on q4b produced a weird drop on our short-code promptset, sending sample set.
Owen (Curation): saw that in the dashboard :eyes:, which cohort is affected? small snippets or multi-line?
Maya (ML): mostly 1-3 line completions, truncation/indentation off, quality metric (BLEU-ish) down ~12% on golden subset.
Leah (Labeling): can we isolate failing examples to relabel? I can spin up a focused batch for quick verification.
Maya (ML): attaching a mini-batch below. please prioritize anything with <ctx 256 and language=python/js
ci-bot: Uploaded 15 examples to labeling queue q://curation/quick-golden-171888
Owen (Curation): thanks. also noticed overlap between current golden and recent seedbank -> possible duplicate noise.
Leah (Labeling): if there are duplicates we should mark them, otherwise labeler time wasted. propose dedupe threshold 0.92 sim.
Sam (Infra): reminder: the dedicated sampler is throttled rn bc of a surge in embed compute, ETA to remove throttle ~40m.
Owen (Curation): can we route the quick-golden to a different sampler endpoint? we need 50/hr to finish verification today.
Sam (Infra): yeah, can route to sampler-2 but it uses smaller batchsize; might increase latency but throughput ok.
Maya (ML): acceptable. for regression triage we need: (1) relabel golden examples, (2) run quant-smoke with kvcache cold and warm, (3) compare to fp baseline.
Leah (Labeling): labeling note: some prompts include inline code fences, we'll add guideline to preserve whitespace and tabs -> lean instructions.
Owen (Curation): also flag any case where output is shorter than expected by >20 tokens as a 'truncation' label.
Maya (ML): good. adding an automated check in eval harness:

```
# quick filter for truncation
if len(pred.split()) < len(ref.split()) - 20:
  tag='truncation'
```

Owen (Curation): can we update golden set after relabel? propose 'suture' process: mark confirmed failures, swap in relabeled variants, keep old examples as 'archived-golden'.
Leah (Labeling): +1. labeling will add a "confidence" meta field so we can prefer high-confidence relabels for immediate swap.
Sam (Infra): to be safe, we can stage the new golden to canary evals for 2 hours before full replace.
Maya (ML): timeline: relabelers finish ~2h, infra routing + canary eval ~1h, then decision point. if regressions persist we roll quant rollback.
Owen (Curation): before swap, I'll run a quick dedupe pass with fuzzyhash and mark collisions; will drop exact duplicates from candidates.
Leah (Labeling): sending a short guideline doc in thread with examples for labelers.
Maya (ML): thanks. also pls capture any examples where quantized model hallucinated extra imports or changed variable names — that's a pattern I want logged.
ci-bot: Labeling batch 171888-A created, 5 active labelers assigned.
Leah (Labeling): ack, starting now. aiming for initial pass in 90m.
Sam (Infra): moved routing for batch to sampler-2, note: add param batch_size=8 to reduce OOM risk.
Owen (Curation): recording ops: dedupe-threshold=0.92, truncation-tag, confidence-priority, canary-window=2h, batch_size=8.
Maya (ML): if canary shows improvement >=8% on our short-code metric we'll proceed with full golden swap; else we revert quant profile and open a deeper bug.
Leah (Labeling): update: found 3 near-duplicates where the ref had trailing comment stripped in ingest -> relabeled to match original formatting.
Owen (Curation): good catch. I'll re-run the selection filter to avoid reintroducing those.
Maya (ML): great. ping me when relabels are in. thanks all.
Sam (Infra): noted. will post when canary eval complete.
ci-bot: Canary eval job 171888-canary started. progress updates in #eng-ml-canary.
Maya (ML): :thumbsup:
summary: coordination thread for relabeling and canarying a golden subset after a quantization regression on short-code prompts, includes dedupe, labeling guidelines, sampler routing, and a staged replacement plan
